aiThesis.rationale:
## IREN Adjusted Thesis (Execution Focus)

If the 38.4% share count expansion is viewed not as value-destructive dilution, but as the necessary front-loading of capital to secure the 5GW+ power pipeline and Blackwell GPU allocations, then the growth trajectory remains intact. 

Furthermore, the hiring of Kambiz Aghili (ex-Oracle Cloud Infrastructure) and Michael Nudelman (ex-Google) suggests that IREN is actively productizing its AI Cloud offering to capture direct enterprise relationships rather than offering basic wholesale colocation. This supports a premium exit multiple (24x base exit PE, up from 22x) and the restoration of our 18%/28% margin targets. Under these parameters, the weighted fair value is $32.19, placing the current quote of $38.27 within the HOLD range (-15.9% variance).
